name: piratetok-live-sh
description: TikTok Live connector in POSIX sh — 64 typed events, auto-reconnect, proxy, helpers. No authentication required.
install: mkdir -p ${PREFIX}/lib/piratetok ${PREFIX}/bin && cp lib/* ${PREFIX}/lib/piratetok/ && cp tiktok-live.sh ${PREFIX}/bin/tiktok-live && chmod +x ${PREFIX}/bin/tiktok-live
author: Zmole Cristian
